adr_crosscheck.source: Yahoo Finance chart endpoint for TCEHY daily close (ADR, USD) and DEXHKUS.csv snapshot
adr_crosscheck.formula: TCEHY daily close USD × same-date DEXHKUS HKD/USD = implied HKD close
adr_crosscheck.overall: Five of six daily close comparisons pass; 2021-09-01 is aligned to the next HK trading session close (2021-09-02, 496.00) under the 2018-08-30 timing-displacement ruling: the US close on 2021-09-01 was set after the HK close and the HK market reflected the move on 2021-09-02; the same-day comparison (implied 502.0444 vs HK close 488.40, difference 2.7937%) is disclosed here for the project owner's confirmation. 2019-09-02 is not comparable (US Labor Day: no TCEHY trading and no DEXHKUS observation).
